## Summary

<!-- What does this pull request change, and why? -->

## Related issue

<!-- For example: Closes #123. New features and breaking changes should have an agreed issue first. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (for example `fix(mix-router): ...`); it becomes the commit message when squash-merged
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, and they failed before the change
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] `pnpm verify:pack` passes (if `package.json` or the build setup changed)
- [ ] Breaking changes are marked with `!` in the title and explained above, with migration steps
- [ ] README.md and README.ja.md are updated if the public API or behavior changed
